categories_shape_check.name: categories_shape_check
categories_shape_check.value: ("categories"."kind" = 'open' AND "categories"."sex" IS NULL AND "categories"."age_limit" IS NULL) OR ("categories"."kind" = 'age' AND "categories"."sex" IN ('male', 'female') AND "categories"."age_limit" BETWEEN 1 AND 100)

cup_playoffs_phase_type_check.name: cup_playoffs_phase_type_check
cup_playoffs_phase_type_check.value: "cup_playoffs"."phase_type" IN ('Oitavas Chave Superior', 'Quartas Chave Superior', 'Semis Chave Superior', 'Final Chave Superior', 'Grande Final', 'Chave Inferior Round 1', 'Chave Inferior Round 2', 'Chave Inferior Round 3', 'Chave Inferior Round 4', 'Quartas Chave Inferior', 'Semis Chave Inferior', 'Final Chave Inferior')

players_rating_range_check.name: players_rating_range_check
players_rating_range_check.value: "players"."blitz" BETWEEN 0 AND 4000 AND "players"."rapid" BETWEEN 0 AND 4000 AND "players"."classic" BETWEEN 0 AND 4000

tv_sergipe_participant_check.name: tv_sergipe_participant_check
tv_sergipe_participant_check.value: ("tv_sergipe"."modality" = 'individual' AND "tv_sergipe"."player_id" IS NOT NULL AND "tv_sergipe"."team_name" IS NULL) OR ("tv_sergipe"."modality" = 'team' AND "tv_sergipe"."player_id" IS NULL AND "tv_sergipe"."team_name" IS NOT NULL)
